- Technical error: LOD Q1 and Q3 both missing (limit of detection not established).

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(here)
library(yaml)
library(arrow)
library(brms)
library(marginaleffects)
library(ggdist)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "10-implementation", "results")
models_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
figures_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(models_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

model_path <- file.path(models_dir, "technical-validity.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: attempted-samples

attempted <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet")
) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  filter(attempted_sample)
```

## Model fit

```{r}
#| label: fit

if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
  fit <- brm(
    ctdna_error_derived ~ 1 + (1 | id),
    data = attempted,
    family = bernoulli("logit"),
    iter = 2000L,
    chains = 4L,
    cores = 1L,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2L,
    refresh = 0L
  )
  saveRDS(fit, model_path, compress = "xz")
}

fit <- readRDS(model_path)
```

## Probability of a technical error

```{r}
#| label: technical-error-probability

technical_draws <- avg_predictions(
  fit,
  newdata = attempted,
  type = "response",
  re_formula = NULL
) |>
  get_draws() |>
  select(draw)

qc_observed <- !is.na(attempted$ctdna_error_qc)

technical_summary <- technical_draws |>
  summarise(
    outcome = "technical_error_probability",
    posterior_mean = mean(draw),
    posterior_median = median(draw),
    lower_95 = quantile(draw, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(draw, 0.975),
    n_attempted_samples = nrow(attempted),
    n_attempted_patients = n_distinct(attempted$id),
    n_derived_errors = sum(attempted$ctdna_error_derived == 1L),
    n_derived_no_error = sum(attempted$ctdna_error_derived == 0L),
    qc_flag_observed = sum(qc_observed),
    qc_flag_discordant = sum(
      qc_observed &
        attempted$ctdna_error_qc != attempted$ctdna_error_derived
    )
  )

write_parquet(
  technical_draws,
  file.path(results_dir, "technical-validity-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  technical_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "technical-validity-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: technical-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Technical validity summary"
#| echo: false

kable(technical_summary)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-technical-error-posterior
#| fig-cap: "Posterior probability of a technical error among attempted ctDNA samples. Thick and thin intervals show 66% and 95% credible intervals."
#| fig-alt: "A half-eye density above a posterior dot plot of the probability that an attempted ctDNA sample had a technical error, in percent, averaged over this trial's attempted samples, with thick and thin intervals for the 66 and 95 percent credible intervals."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

# No reference line: a probability has no natural reference value.
technical_posterior_plot <- plot_posterior(
  100 * technical_draws$draw,
  x_label = "Probability of technical error per attempted sample, %",
  reference = NULL
)

save_figure(
  technical_posterior_plot,
  file.path(figures_dir, "technical-error-posterior.png"),
  height = 5
)
technical_posterior_plot
```
